unit.why: A single narrative: R. Itzikl of Radvil heals a duchess's son, who later becomes a high judicial official and frees him and other tzaddikim from a denunciation.

stories.start_quote: מחו׳ הרה״ק ר׳ איציקל מראדוויל פלאי פלאות
stories.end_quote: גם להצדיקים הנ"ל טובה על ידו זי"ע
stories.summary_en: As a young maggid in Nadvorna, R. Itzikl of Radvil promises a weeping duchess that her dying son will recover so that he may one day benefit Israel; the boy grows up to head the court officials in Zhitomir, and when R. Itzikl, R. Motele of Chernobyl and the Ruzhiner are denounced and summoned there, he recognizes R. Itzikl, honors him and releases him, benefiting the other tzaddikim too.
